disclaimer: Which curated, publicly traded active managers added or cut a position between their two most recent distinct 13F reporting periods. Not a claim about why, and coverage is necessarily partial - large privately held managers (Renaissance Technologies, Citadel Advisors, Bridgewater, ...) have no ticker and are not reachable this way. Each result's `as_of` is the SEC filing date, which trails the quarter it describes by up to 45 days - advisor_engine.institutional_ownership_modifier decays its score contribution by that lag rather than treating it as current.
